Jackie Dungeon — walkthrough — Twilio Studio build sheet
============================================================

Widgets: 39 of 1000
Longest route: ~24 steps (cap is 1000 per call)

Rooms are ordered shallowest first, so working down this sheet means
descending the dungeon.

A dungeon loops, so some transitions necessarily point at rooms further
down the sheet. Those are marked (later) — drop the widget in now and
wire that transition once you reach its target, or place every widget
first and wire the whole flow afterwards.

Nothing in this flow is spoken by Twilio. Anything without a recording is
simply not emitted, so a room, round or refusal with no take is silence on
the phone. The audio manifest lists every one of them.

BEFORE YOU START — things to check:
  ! ENTRANCE digit 2 has a reaction written ("The stairs are wet. Something moves belo…") with no recording, so the caller hears nothing between pressing and arriving.
  ! ENTRANCE digit 3 ("listen to the music") is an unwritten branch — it has nowhere to go and is exported as a repeat.
  ! HOLD digit 1: "The rope is heavier than it looked. Salt" is written for an item changing hands but has no recording, so the caller hears nothing at that moment.
  ! SHARKS round 3 has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before answering it.
  ! SHORE plays line by line and 1 of its 3 lines have no take — those lines are silent.
  ! SHORE digit 2 refuses the caller with no recording, so they are sent back to the choices without being told why.
  ! LOCKER has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before the choices.
  ! FIN has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before the choices.
  ! CUT_SCENE has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before the choices.
  ! CUT_SCENE is a room with no exits and is not an ending — a caller reaching it can only time out.

─── CUT_SCENE  (room, no audio yet) ────────────────
 1. Gather             CUT_SCENE_gather
      # Stop gathering after 1 digit; 5s timeout.
      → keypress               : CUT_SCENE_keys
      → speech                 : CUT_SCENE_keys
      → timeout                : CUT_SCENE_gather

 2. Split Based On     CUT_SCENE_keys
      # Which key was pressed. Anything unlisted is a wrong keypress.
      Split on: {{widgets.CUT_SCENE_gather.Digits}}
      → noMatch                : CUT_SCENE_gather

─── DECK  (room, recorded) ────────────────
 1. Say/Play           DECK_play
      # Play the recorded audio.
      Play URL: demo/deck.mp3
      → audioComplete          : DECK_gather

 2. Gather             DECK_gather
      # Stop gathering after 1 digit; 5s timeout.
      → keypress               : DECK_keys
      → speech                 : DECK_keys
      → timeout                : DECK_play

 3. Split Based On     DECK_keys
      # Which key was pressed. Anything unlisted is a wrong keypress.
      Split on: {{widgets.DECK_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : SHARKS_play  (later)
      → noMatch                : DECK_play

─── DROWNED  (ending, recorded) ────────────────
 1. Say/Play           DROWNED_play
      # Play the recorded audio.
      Play URL: demo/drowned.mp3
      → audioComplete          : (nowhere)

─── ENTRANCE  (room, recorded) ────────────────
 1. Say/Play           ENTRANCE_play
      # Play the recorded audio.
      Play URL: demo/entrance.mp3
      → audioComplete          : ENTRANCE_gather

 2. Gather             ENTRANCE_gather
      # Stop gathering after 1 digit; 5s timeout.
      → keypress               : ENTRANCE_keys
      → speech                 : ENTRANCE_keys
      → timeout                : ENTRANCE_play

 3. Split Based On     ENTRANCE_keys
      # Which key was pressed. Anything unlisted is a wrong keypress.
      Split on: {{widgets.ENTRANCE_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : DECK_play
      → Digits equals 2        : HOLD_gates  (later)
      → Digits equals 3        : ENTRANCE_gather
      → noMatch                : ENTRANCE_play

─── FIN  (ending, no audio yet) ────────────────
─── HOLD  (room, recorded) ────────────────
 1. Set Variables      HOLD_gates
      # All 1 gate(s) on this room, batched into one widget (§6.3).
      gate_HOLD_d2 = {% assign inv = flow.variables.inv | default: "|" %}{% if inv contains "|ROPE|" %}pass{% else %}fail{% endif %}
      → next                   : HOLD_play

 2. Say/Play           HOLD_play
      # Play the recorded audio.
      Play URL: demo/hold.mp3
      → audioComplete          : HOLD_gather

 3. Set Variables      HOLD_d1_fx
      # Effects for pressing 1.
      inv = {% assign cur = flow.variables.inv | default: "|" %}{% if cur contains "|ROPE|" %}{{ cur }}{% else %}{{ cur }}ROPE|{% endif %}
      → next                   : SHARKS_play  (later)

 4. Split Based On     HOLD_d2_gate
      # Gate on digit 2; the boolean was computed in HOLD_gates.
      Split on: {{flow.variables.gate_HOLD_d2}}
      → Equal To pass          : (nowhere)
      → noMatch                : DROWNED_play

 5. Gather             HOLD_gather
      # Stop gathering after 1 digit; 5s timeout.
      → keypress               : HOLD_keys
      → speech                 : HOLD_keys
      → timeout                : HOLD_play

 6. Split Based On     HOLD_keys
      # Which key was pressed. Anything unlisted is a wrong keypress.
      Split on: {{widgets.HOLD_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : HOLD_d1_fx
      → Digits equals 2        : HOLD_d2_gate
      → noMatch                : HOLD_play

─── LOCKER  (room, no audio yet) ────────────────
 1. Gather             LOCKER_gather
      # Stop gathering after 1 digit; 5s timeout.
      → keypress               : LOCKER_keys
      → speech                 : LOCKER_keys
      → timeout                : LOCKER_gather

 2. Split Based On     LOCKER_keys
      # Which key was pressed. Anything unlisted is a wrong keypress.
      Split on: {{widgets.LOCKER_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : LOCKER_gather
      → noMatch                : LOCKER_gather

─── SHARKS  (room, recorded) ────────────────
 1. Say/Play           SHARKS_play
      # Play the recorded audio.
      Play URL: demo/sharks.mp3
      → audioComplete          : SHARKS_reset

 2. Say/Play           SHARKS_r1_play
      # Round 1: The shark throws Rising Tiger.
      Play URL: demo/r1.mp3
      → audioComplete          : SHARKS_r1_gather

 3. Gather             SHARKS_r1_gather
      # 1=PUNCH, 2=KICK, 3=BLOCK. Any other digit, and silence, takes the losing route.
      → keypress               : SHARKS_r1_keys
      → speech                 : SHARKS_r1_keys
      → timeout                : SHARKS_r1_waited

 4. Split Based On     SHARKS_r1_keys
      # Which move the caller answered with.
      Split on: {{widgets.SHARKS_r1_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : SHARKS_r2_play
      → Digits equals 2        : DROWNED_play
      → Digits equals 3        : DROWNED_play
      → noMatch                : DROWNED_play

 5. Set Variables      SHARKS_r1_waited
      # The caller said nothing. Count it.
      SHARKS_r1_silence = {{ flow.variables.SHARKS_r1_silence | default: 0 | plus: 1 }}
      → next                   : SHARKS_r1_patience

 6. Split Based On     SHARKS_r1_patience
      # Repeat the round up to 3 times, then the fight is called.
      Split on: {{flow.variables.SHARKS_r1_silence}}
      → Less than 3            : SHARKS_r1_play
      → noMatch                : DROWNED_play

 7. Say/Play           SHARKS_r2_play
      # Round 2: The shark throws Low Roll.
      Play URL: demo/r2.mp3
      → audioComplete          : SHARKS_r2_gather

 8. Gather             SHARKS_r2_gather
      # 1=PUNCH, 2=KICK, 3=BLOCK. Any other digit, and silence, takes the losing route.
      → keypress               : SHARKS_r2_keys
      → speech                 : SHARKS_r2_keys
      → timeout                : SHARKS_r2_waited

 9. Split Based On     SHARKS_r2_keys
      # Which move the caller answered with.
      Split on: {{widgets.SHARKS_r2_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : DROWNED_play
      → Digits equals 2        : SHARKS_r3_gather
      → Digits equals 3        : DROWNED_play
      → noMatch                : DROWNED_play

 10. Set Variables      SHARKS_r2_waited
      # The caller said nothing. Count it.
      SHARKS_r2_silence = {{ flow.variables.SHARKS_r2_silence | default: 0 | plus: 1 }}
      → next                   : SHARKS_r2_patience

 11. Split Based On     SHARKS_r2_patience
      # Repeat the round up to 3 times, then the fight is called.
      Split on: {{flow.variables.SHARKS_r2_silence}}
      → Less than 3            : SHARKS_r2_play
      → noMatch                : DROWNED_play

 12. Gather             SHARKS_r3_gather
      # 1=PUNCH, 2=KICK, 3=BLOCK. Any other digit, and silence, takes the losing route.
      → keypress               : SHARKS_r3_keys
      → speech                 : SHARKS_r3_keys
      → timeout                : SHARKS_r3_waited

 13. Split Based On     SHARKS_r3_keys
      # Which move the caller answered with.
      Split on: {{widgets.SHARKS_r3_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : DROWNED_play
      → Digits equals 2        : DROWNED_play
      → Digits equals 3        : SHORE_gates  (later)
      → noMatch                : DROWNED_play

 14. Set Variables      SHARKS_r3_waited
      # The caller said nothing. Count it.
      SHARKS_r3_silence = {{ flow.variables.SHARKS_r3_silence | default: 0 | plus: 1 }}
      → next                   : SHARKS_r3_patience

 15. Split Based On     SHARKS_r3_patience
      # Repeat the round up to 3 times, then the fight is called.
      Split on: {{flow.variables.SHARKS_r3_silence}}
      → Less than 3            : SHARKS_r3_gather
      → noMatch                : DROWNED_play

 16. Set Variables      SHARKS_reset
      # Clear the silence counters, so re-entering this fight starts fresh.
      SHARKS_r1_silence = 0
      SHARKS_r2_silence = 0
      SHARKS_r3_silence = 0
      → next                   : SHARKS_r1_play

─── SHORE  (room, no audio yet) ────────────────
 1. Set Variables      SHORE_gates
      # All 1 gate(s) on this room, batched into one widget (§6.3).
      gate_SHORE_d2 = {% assign inv = flow.variables.inv | default: "|" %}{% if inv contains "|ROPE|" %}pass{% else %}fail{% endif %}
      → next                   : SHORE_play

 2. Say/Play           SHORE_play
      # Play the recorded audio. — Carter
      Play URL: demo/shore-1.mp3
      → audioComplete          : SHORE_line2

 3. Say/Play           SHORE_line2
      # Play the recorded audio. — Carter
      Play URL: demo/shore-3.mp3
      → audioComplete          : SHORE_gather

 4. Split Based On     SHORE_d2_gate
      # Gate on digit 2; the boolean was computed in SHORE_gates.
      Split on: {{flow.variables.gate_SHORE_d2}}
      → Equal To pass          : LOCKER_gather
      → noMatch                : SHORE_gather

 5. Gather             SHORE_gather
      # Stop gathering after 1 digit; 5s timeout.
      → keypress               : SHORE_keys
      → speech                 : SHORE_keys
      → timeout                : SHORE_play

 6. Split Based On     SHORE_keys
      # Which key was pressed. Anything unlisted is a wrong keypress.
      Split on: {{widgets.SHORE_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : SHORE_gather
      → Digits equals 2        : SHORE_d2_gate
      → noMatch                : SHORE_play


PATIENCE VALVE
Studio stops an execution if the same widget runs 10 times in a row, so a caller
mashing a locked door gets hung up on. Route the 8th consecutive refusal to an
escape node instead of back to the gather.

script:
Jackie Dungeon — walkthrough
============================================================

## CUT_SCENE — A room nothing leads to

Written, then stranded.


## DECK — The listing deck
(recorded, not yet approved)

The deck tilts. Something circles below the waterline.

   Press 1 to dive


## DROWNED — Down
(approved)

The water closes. The line goes dead.


## ENTRANCE — The hotline
(approved)

  Mike: Someone actually picked up.
  Carter: Of course they did. Look at the water.

   Press 1 to go up on deck
   Press 2 to go below
   Press 3 to listen to the music


## FIN — Ashore

You make it out. You do not look back.


## HOLD — The flooded hold
(recorded, not yet approved)

Water to the ankle. A coil of rope floats past.

   Press 1 to swim for it
   Press 2 to climb the ladder


## LOCKER — The locker

Bolted shut. The rope would hold your weight.

   Press 1 to climb out


## SHARKS — Circled
(recorded, not yet approved)

It surfaces. It has been waiting.

   [fight: The shark]
   1. Rising Tiger Shark! It comes up under you.
        1 PUNCH → round 2
        2 KICK → Down
        3 BLOCK → Down
   2. It rolls low and fast.
        1 PUNCH → Down
        2 KICK → round 3
        3 BLOCK → Down
   3. It breaches. This is the last of it.
        1 PUNCH → Down
        2 KICK → Down
        3 BLOCK → The shore


## SHORE — The shore

  Carter: You are bleeding.
  Mike: I know what I am.
  Carter: We are not doing that again.

   Press 1 to walk inland
   Press 2 to force the locker
